上集“二士争功”，叙司马昭遣钟会、邓艾分路伐蜀，
灭蜀后二将争功，互相攻讦，两败俱伤。
本集为三国演义连环画结尾一册，叙司马昭病死，长
子司马炎嗣位，废了魏帝，建立晋朝。司马炎用名将羊祜遗策，出
兵征吴；吴主孙皓投降，三国归于一统。

1. 司马昭灭了蜀国以后，朝中大臣说他立了大功，奏请魏主曹奂封他为
王。曹奂不敢不从，就封晋公司马昭为晋王。

Content Summary
The previous volume, "Two Generals Contend for Merit," narrates how Sima Zhao sent Zhong Hui and Deng Ai to attack Shu along separate routes. After Shu's fall, the two generals quarreled over credit, attacked each other, and both suffered heavy losses.
This volume is the final installment of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms illustrated series. It recounts Sima Zhao's death, his eldest son Sima Yan succeeding him, deposing the Wei emperor, and establishing the Jin dynasty. Sima Yan employed the legacy strategy of the renowned general Yang Hu to launch a campaign against Wu; Wu's ruler Sun Hao surrendered, and the Three Kingdoms were reunified.

1. After Sima Zhao destroyed the state of Shu, court ministers claimed he had achieved great merit and petitioned Emperor Cao Huan of Wei to grant him the title of king. Cao Huan dared not refuse, and thus conferred the title of King of Jin upon Sima Zhao.
summary_zh: 本页为绘本《三国归晋》的第2页，上半部分是内容提要，简述了上集情节和本集主要内容，即司马昭病逝后其子司马炎建立晋朝并统一三国。下半部分为第一幅插图，配文说明司马昭灭蜀后被封为晋王。
